summary: Six hikers left the Gregory Canyon Trailhead heading toward Bluebell Shelter on Jan. 24 and lost the trail after nightfall; found safe and warm less than 100 yards from the parking lot and assisted down by Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (BCSO, Boulder Fire Rescue, and City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks also responded)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Boulder Fire Rescue; City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: page states only 'Jan. 24'; surrounding police-blotter items dated Jan. 29-30 place publication in early Feb 2016, so 2016-01-24 (Sunday) is the strong inference; 2015-01-24 (Saturday) cannot be fully excluded. Zero Gregory Canyon/Bluebell rows 2015-2016 and zero 6-victim rows 2015-01-20..2016-02-10 -- genuinely new. BCSO line, run 610 (this attempt); source parent-opened this run.
